title: Verification ladder
alt: Four verification tiers from editor LSP to git hooks, local gate stages, and CI PR admission re-checking Exit-0 receipts.
text: Local Workstation: 1. Editor LSP (cmd/standards-lsp), 2. Git Hooks (lefthook pre-commit & pre-push), 3. Gate Pipeline (6 stages in internal/gating), Signing Key (PRAETOR_RECEIPT_KEY), .standards-receipt.json (Exit-0 receipt).
Remote CI & Admission: Pull Request (checklist & ```receipt block), 4. CI Re-check (standardsctl forge validate-pr), Admitted (PR status check passes), Rejected (hook block or CI exit 1).
1. Editor LSP → 2. Git Hooks (save / stage) → 3. Gate Pipeline (commit / push).
Signing Key → 3. Gate Pipeline (LoadSigningKey) → .standards-receipt.json (signed v2) → Pull Request (fenced in body) → 4. CI Re-check (validate-pr) → Admitted (valid receipt).

Scenario 1, clean change -> admitted: A clean change passes all four tiers and is admitted by CI. Editor LSP reports zero diagnostics as code is written. Pre-commit and pre-push hooks run local checks and linters. Gate runs 6 stages; Ed25519 signing key is loaded. Stage output signed; .standards-receipt.json minted for HEAD commit. PR is opened with checked HISS boxes and fenced receipt block. CI runs standardsctl forge validate-pr on the PR description. Signature, clean worktree, and head SHA match: PR is admitted.

Scenario 2, a hook blocks locally: A local hook blocks commit or push before CI runs. Change introduces an error or invariant violation. Lefthook pre-commit or pre-push hook rejects the change locally.

Scenario 3, CI rejects invalid receipt: CI rejects a pull request with a missing or invalid receipt. Code is edited and committed. Local checks pass. PR submitted with missing, unpinned, or mismatched receipt. CI step runs standardsctl forge validate-pr. Receipt verification fails: commit mismatch, dirty tree, or missing block.
Verification escalates through four tiers: real-time editor diagnostics, local git hooks, the six-stage gate pipeline, and CI PR admission.
